{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-id-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"8cfbea71935f90057615d66e5e1e4e32908bcb7bedfa7c976e248d332eecbda4","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-id-class-d:lineage:1","source_registry_sha256":"9c432577e712960022ff656d6738a091319c6e5e4dcbdcf9429cd450e142e543","source_liveness_sha256":"eee60602368bd429216c9c2833be0be6ed9e505e5c5accebaefb9d2b9a847475"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Licensing basics and graduated licensing","heading":"C — Licensing basics and graduated licensing","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Licensing basics and graduated licensing

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A03
Driving a motor vehicle on Idaho’s public highways requires a current driver’s license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0003]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A03
Idaho permits licensing beginning at age fifteen. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0003]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A03
Applicants younger than seventeen must finish approved driver training and the graduated licensing program before licensing. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0003]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A03
ITD provides reasonable disability accommodations and equal access to its facilities, programs and services. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0003]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A03
A skills examiner must administer an equal test regardless of an applicant’s disability. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0003]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A04
A person moving to Idaho must apply for an Idaho license within thirty days of establishing residence, even if the prior license remains valid. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A04
An Idaho college or university student may retain a valid other-state license when claiming residency in that other state. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A04
Active-duty military members, their spouses and dependents may retain valid other-state licenses while claiming residence in that state. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A12
An Idaho license applicant must surrender licenses and identification cards issued by another state, a United States territory or the District of Columbia. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A12
A transfer applicant from another state, a United States territory or the District of Columbia must pass Idaho’s Class D knowledge test. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A12
A transfer applicant whose license expired at least twenty-five months earlier must also take the skills test. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A12
Receiving a credential from another jurisdiction cancels the Idaho credential. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A12
A foreign license holder receiving an Idaho Class D license is not required to hand over the foreign license. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A12
After receiving an Idaho Class D license, a driver may not display or use the foreign license as driving authority. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A12
A driver who uses the foreign license after receiving Idaho Class D authority may face a misdemeanor citation and fine. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A12
An applicant seeking disability accommodations should give the county DMV two weeks to arrange them. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A13
An Idaho driver must carry the driver’s license while operating a vehicle. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A13
Misusing or mutilating a license, instruction permit or identification card is a misdemeanor. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A13
A worn, broken or damaged license must be replaced with a duplicate. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A13
Knowingly supplying false information on a credential application can lead to perjury prosecution and cancellation of the credential. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A14
Outstanding license suspensions, cancellations or revocations in another jurisdiction must be cleared before Idaho can issue a license. [A14]
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A14
County sheriff driver’s license offices issue Idaho licenses, identification cards and instruction permits. [A14]
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A14
An Idaho credential photograph must show the face fully from the front. [A14]
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A14
Applicants generally remove face or head coverings for the credential photograph, with possible medical or religious exceptions. [A14]
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A15
An Idaho Class D license authorizes operation of non-commercial motor vehicles. [A15]
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A15
A driver training permit lets a person aged fourteen and a half through under seventeen attend an approved public or private driver training program. [A15]
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A15
During enrollment in driver training, the training permit allows driving only with the training instructor. [A15]
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A15
Successful driver training completion and return of the permit by the instructor make the applicant eligible to begin supervised instruction. [A15]
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A16
A parent or guardian with verifiable custody or guardianship must act as liability signer for an applicant younger than eighteen. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F30 | anchor: A16
A person aged eighteen may apply for a Class D instruction permit without a liability signer. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F31 | anchor: A16
An applicant aged seventeen or older can use a Class D instruction permit for one year of accompanied driving practice. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F32 | anchor: A16
The adult accompanying a Class D instruction permit holder must be at least eighteen and hold a valid driver’s license. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F33 | anchor: A16
Issuance of a Class D instruction permit requires passing the knowledge test. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F34 | anchor: A16
A driver younger than sixteen is limited to daylight driving unless a licensed driver aged at least twenty-one occupies the adjacent front seat. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-F35 | anchor: A16
For the under-sixteen driving restriction, Idaho defines daylight as five in the morning through ten at night in local time. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

Misconceptions: A training permit does not allow unrestricted solo driving; supervision depends on the permit stage.
Mnemonic: Learn, supervise, then test is a teaching reminder for the graduated path.
Glossary: Class D means the non-commercial license; GDL names graduated licensing; DT identifies the driver training permit; IP identifies the instruction permit.
Dynamic facts: dated credential access policies, local service details and fee amounts are kept as verification debt outside the knowledge blocks.
